data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation from a diversified portfolio that dynamically invests in equity and equity-related securities of companies across various market capitalisation. However, there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be realized.
data.asset_allocation:
1. Equity and Equity related securities across market cap - 65-100%
2. Debt & Money Market Instruments - 0-35%
data.exit_load:
• If the units are redeemed / switched out on or before 90 days from the date of allotment – 1.00%
• If the units are redeemed / switched out after 90 days from the date of allotment – Nil
